original: उत्तरं यत्समुद्रस्य हिमाद्रेश्चैव दक्षिणम् । वर्षं तद् भारतं नाम भारती यत्र संततिः ॥
transliteration: uttaraṃ yatsamudrasya himādreścaiva dakṣiṇam | varṣaṃ tad bhārataṃ nāma bhāratī yatra saṃtatiḥ ||
translation: The sacred land north of the ocean and south of the Himalayas is named Bharata; there dwell the noble descendants of Bharata.
meaning: Dvitiya Amsa — Sacred Geography of Bharatavarsha (Verse 2.1): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 2, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: विष्णुपुराण अंश 2 का यह श्लोक धर्म, भक्ति और आत्मज्ञान का स्पष्ट निरूपण करता है।

layers.content: श्रीधर स्वामींच्या आत्मप्रकाश टीकेनुसार हा श्लोक ईश्वरी कृपेने मुक्ती मिळवण्याचा मार्ग दाखवतो.

original: अत्रापि भारतं श्रेष्ठं जम्बूद्वीपे महामुने । यतो हि कर्मभूरेषा ततोऽन्या भोगभूमयः ॥
transliteration: atrāpi bhārataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jambūdvīpe mahāmune | yato hi karmabhūreṣā tato'nyā bhogabhūmayaḥ ||
translation: Here in Jambudvipa, Bharata is supreme, for this is the land of righteous action (Karmabhumi), while all others are realms of mere enjoyment.
meaning: Dvitiya Amsa — Sacred Geography of Bharatavarsha (Verse 2.2): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 2, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

original: संप्राप्य भारते जन्म मानुषे विमले कुले । यः करोति शुभं कर्म स याति परमां गतिम् ॥
transliteration: saṃprāpya bhārate janma mānuṣe vimale kule | yaḥ karoti śubhaṃ karma sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
translation: Whoever obtains human birth in Bharata in a noble family and performs righteous deeds ascends unto the highest destiny.
meaning: Dvitiya Amsa — Sacred Geography of Bharatavarsha (Verse 2.3): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 2, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

original: सप्त कुलाचला अत्र महेन्द्रो मलयः सह्यः । शुक्तिमान् ऋक्षपर्वतश्च विन्ध्यश्च पारियात्रकः ॥
transliteration: sapta kulācalā atra mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ | śuktimān ṛkṣaparvataśca vindhyaśca pāriyātrakaḥ ||
translation: Seven are the sacred principal mountain ranges of Bharata: Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Shuktiman, Riksha, Vindhya, and Pariyatra.
meaning: Dvitiya Amsa — Sacred Geography of Bharatavarsha (Verse 2.4): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 2, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

original: गंगा सरस्वती सिन्धुश्चन्द्रभागा तथापरा । पिबन्ति यतयो नद्यो विष्णोः पादोद्भवं पयः ॥
transliteration: gaṃgā sarasvatī sindhuścandrabhāgā tathāparā | pibanti yatayo nadyo viṣṇoḥ pādodbhavaṃ payaḥ ||
translation: The holy rivers Ganga, Saraswati, Sindhu, Chandrabhaga, and others flow forth, whose sacred waters origin from the feet of Lord Vishnu.
meaning: Dvitiya Amsa — Sacred Geography of Bharatavarsha (Verse 2.5): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 2, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

original: वर्णाश्रमाचारवता पुरुषेण परः पुमान् । विष्णुराराध्यते पन्था नान्यस्तत्तोषकारकः ॥
transliteration: varṇāśramācāravatā puruṣeṇa paraḥ pumān | viṣṇurārādhyate panthā nānyastattoṣakārakaḥ ||
translation: By adhering to the ethical duties of one's station in life, Lord Vishnu is worshipped; there is no other path that pleases Him so deeply.
meaning: Dvitiya Amsa — Sacred Geography of Bharatavarsha (Verse 2.6): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 2, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.content: विष्णुपुराण अंश 2 का यह श्लोक धर्म, भक्ति और आत्मज्ञान का स्पष्ट निरूपण करता है।

original: अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः । एतं सामासिकं धर्मं चातुर्वर्ण्येऽब्रवीन्मनुः ॥
transliteration: ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ | etaṃ sāmāsikaṃ dharmaṃ cāturvarṇye'bravīnmanuḥ ||
translation: Non-violence, truthfulness, non-stealing, purity, and sensory self-control: this is the universal dharma declared for all humanity.
meaning: Dvitiya Amsa — Sacred Geography of Bharatavarsha (Verse 2.7): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 2, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

original: जम्बूद्वीपं समभितो लवणाम्बुधिरुच्यते । तत्परं प्लक्षद्वीपं च क्रौञ्चद्वीपं तथैव च ॥
transliteration: jambūdvīpaṃ samabhito lavaṇāmbudhirucyate | tatparaṃ plakṣadvīpaṃ ca krauñcadvīpaṃ tathaiva ca ||
translation: Surrounding Jambudvipa is the vast Salt Ocean; beyond lie Plaksha, Shalmala, Kusha, Krauncha, Shaka, and Pushkara dvipas.
meaning: Dvitiya Amsa — Sacred Geography of Bharatavarsha (Verse 2.8): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 2, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

original: सूर्यरथस्य संचाराद्दिनरात्रिप्रवर्तनम् । लोकपालनियोगेन कालो भ्रमति संततम् ॥
transliteration: sūryarathasya saṃcārāddinarātripravartanam | lokapālaniyogena kālo bhramati saṃtatam ||
translation: By the majestic movement of the Sun's chariot, day and night revolve; by cosmic ordinance, time marches ceaselessly on.
meaning: Dvitiya Amsa — Sacred Geography of Bharatavarsha (Verse 2.9): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 2, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.content: श्रीधर स्वामींच्या आत्मप्रकाश टीकेनुसार हा श्लोक ईश्वरी कृपेने मुक्ती मिळवण्याचा मार्ग दाखवतो.

original: तदेतत्सर्वमेवैष भगवान् हरिरीश्वरः । नान्योऽस्ति जगतां भर्ता विष्णोः परतरं न हि ॥
transliteration: tadetat sarvameva Bhagavān harirīśvaraḥ | nānyo'sti jagatāṃ bhartā viṣṇoḥ parataraṃ na hi ||
translation: All of this cosmic geography is indeed Lord Hari Himself; there is no other preserver of the universe, none superior to Vishnu.
meaning: Dvitiya Amsa — Sacred Geography of Bharatavarsha (Verse 2.10): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 2, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.
